title: Threatened student class boycott over unpaid allowances
reason: The 3 September Gazette article reports a conditional threat to boycott in-person classes if allowances were not paid by 9 September. The article does not report a boycott that occurred; follow-up searches did not verify one.
notes: Absence of a located follow-up is not proof no boycott occurred; preserve as an unverified planned action, not an event.
